title: HustleBox v1.2.4 — Sound, Voices, and a Real Sign-In
message:
Auth got a real UI. Audio got a real soundtrack.

NEW SIGN-IN FLOW
The cluttered all-options-visible Account section is gone. In its place: two clean buttons — Log In and Sign Up. Tapping either opens a polished modal with:
• 🔗 Continue with Google (primary big button — most secure, no password stored)
• 👤 Continue as Guest (secondary)
• ✉️ Sign in with Email — small text link, de-emphasized

Picking Email opens a sub-view of the modal with a Log In / Sign Up toggle, email + password fields, and a note that Google is the more secure option. Modeled after how TikTok, Instagram, and GitHub do their sign-in flows.

The modal closes on backdrop tap, the X button, or successful auth. Email auto-complete attributes are set correctly so password managers work.

SOUND EFFECTS
• 🔔 Bell ding when you serve an order successfully
• 🍳 Sizzle when a new customer arrives
• 🪙 Coin drop when you earn Stacks
• All synthesized with the Web Audio API — no asset files, no bundle bloat
• Tied to the existing Sound Effects toggle (renamed from 'Sound')

BACKGROUND AMBIENCE (NEW TOGGLE)
Subtle low-frequency street/city noise plays while you're working a shift. Off by default — turn it on in Settings if you want that food-truck-at-night vibe. Auto-stops when you leave the Work tab.

CUSTOMER VOICES (NEW TOGGLE)
New experimental setting: when a customer arrives, they speak their order out loud. Uses your device's built-in text-to-speech with a randomly picked voice + pitch each time so customers sound different. Off by default — quality and voice availability varies by device and browser. Best on Android Chrome and modern iOS Safari.

No save data wiped. Existing accounts still work. Cloud sync unchanged.

highlights: Auth UI redesigned: two-button entry + modal with method picker
Google = primary recommended option; Email de-emphasized as a small text link
Bell ding, sizzle, and coin drop SFX during shifts
Background Ambience toggle — subtle synthesized street noise
Customer Voices toggle — orders spoken via device TTS (experimental)
Sound setting renamed to Sound Effects
Email form opens to Sign Up or Log In based on which button you tapped
Password manager autocomplete attributes added
